dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Consistent geometric narrowing from the maximum mid-body width toward a sharp, pointed posterior termination at the peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a slight asymmetrical convex protrusion visible on the mid-right lateral edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal surface with minimal tonal variance.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single, high-contrast, circular dark-pixel cluster on the anterior dorsal midline; scattered low-contrast, circular light spots present on the right dorsal flank.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Distinct longitudinal ridge-line extending along the central dorsal axis from the mid-body to the posterior peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark circular mark at the anterior dorsal interface; otherwise no distinct healed lesions or rake marks visible.
